bio: Completely surrounded by nature, in the heart of the Serranía de Cuenca and opposite the turn-off that takes us to the source of the Cuervo river, this rustic restaurant is perfect if you are looking for a little disconnection, or the warmth of the firewood in winter. They offer traditional cuisine that does everything possible to make the most of the surroundings, with good game meats and mushrooms in season (we loved their Revuelto de boletus y perrechicos)....
